                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਉਹ ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਨਿਆਂਪੂਰਨ ਸਮਾਜ ਦੀ ਸਿਰਜਣਾ ਲਈ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ-ਨਿਰਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਵਜੋਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਰਾਖਵਾਂਕਰਨ ਨੀਤੀ\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਭਾਰਤ ਦੀ ਰਾਖਵਾਂਕਰਨ ਨੀਤੀ ਸਕਾਰਾਤਮਕ ਕਾਰਵਾਈ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਰੂਪ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਪਛੜੇ ਅਤੇ ਘੱਟ-ਪ੍ਰਤਿਨਿਧ ਭਾਈਚਾਰਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਭਲਾਈ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ, ਰੁਜ਼ਗਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਨਿਧਤਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਾਖਵਾਂਕਰਨ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇਸ ਨੀਤੀ ਦਾ ਉਦੇਸ਼ ਅਨੁਸੂਚਿਤ ਜਾਤੀਆਂ (SCs), ਅਨੁਸੂਚਿਤ ਕਬੀਲਿਆਂ (STs), ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਪਛੜੇ ਵਰਗਾਂ (OBCs) ਲਈ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਨਿਧਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਮੌਕਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾਉਣਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਰਾਖਵਾਂਕਰਨ ਸੰਵਿਧਾਨ ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਧਾਰਾਵਾਂ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਕਿ ਧਾਰਾ 15(4), 16(4), ਅਤੇ 46 ਦੇ ਤਹਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਭਾਰਤੀ ਸੰਵਿਧਾਨ ਦੀ ਧਾਰਾ 14 ਗਾਰੰਟੀ ਦਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਹਰ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇਹ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਰਾਜ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੇ ਖੇਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਕਾਨੂੰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਤੋਂ ਇਨਕਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰੇਗਾ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇਹ ਸਿਧਾਂਤ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਦੇ ਰਾਜ ਲਈ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਕੋਈ ਵੀ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਜਾਂ ਸਮੂਹ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਪਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇਹ ਕਾਨੂੰਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਰਪੱਖਤਾ ਨੂੰ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਅਧਾਰ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n139:Td99,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is The Regulating Act, 1773.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Regulating Act, 1773 was the first act passed by the British Parliament to control the administration of the East India Company in India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It marked the beginning of parliamentary oversight and introduced significant administrative reforms in the governance of the company.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Act designated the Governor of Bengal as the Governor-General of Bengal, with Warren Hastings being the first to hold this position.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Governor-General was given authority over the presidencies of Madras and Bombay, establishing a centralized administrative structure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A Supreme Court was also established in Calcutta (now Kolkata) as part of the act to administer justice according to British law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Government of India Act, 1858\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This act marked the end of the East India Company's rule and the beginning of direct control by the British Crown.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • It transferred the administration of India to the British monarchy, establishing the office of the Secretary of State for India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The act aimed to improve governance and centralize authority under the British government.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Government of India Act, 1909\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Also known as the Morley-Minto Reforms, this act introduced significant changes in the Indian legislative structure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • It expanded the legislative councils at both central and provincial levels and allowed for greater Indian representation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The act introduced separate electorates for Muslims, a significant development in Indian political history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Government of India Act, 1935\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This was the longest act passed by the British Parliament concerning the governance of India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • It proposed the establishment of a federal structure in India, including the creation of provinces and princely states.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The act introduced provincial autonomy and expanded the electorate significantly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • It laid the foundation for the eventual independence and partition of India in 1947.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is 1 year.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The PM-SVANidhi Scheme was launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs in June 2020.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The scheme provides working capital loans up to ₹10,000 to urban street vendors.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The loan tenure is one year, and it is repayable in monthly installments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • On timely or early repayment of the loan, the vendors are eligible for an interest subsidy of 7% per annum.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The scheme aims to empower street vendors by not only providing loans but also incentivizing digital transactions through cashback offers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Eligibility:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Street vendors in urban areas, including those vending in surrounding peri-urban/rural areas.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Vendors who were in business on or before March 24, 2020.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Loan Features:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Collateral-free loan.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Initial working capital loan up to ₹10,000.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Interest subsidy of 7% per annum on timely repayment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Digital Transactions:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Vendors are incentivized for digital transactions through monthly cashback.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Cashback ranges between ₹50-₹100 per month.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Implementation:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The scheme is implemented through Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) play a significant role in the implementation process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Beneficiary Identification:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Surveyed vendors identified in the ULBs' survey.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Non-surveyed vendors, if identified, can be included through a simple application process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n190:T1", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          सही उत्तर 1 वर्ष है।Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • पीएम-स्वनिधि योजना जून 2020 में आवास और शहरी मामलों के मंत्रालय द्वारा शुरू की गई थी।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • यह योजना शहरी पथ विक्रेताओं को 10,000 रुपये तक का कार्यशील पूँजी ऋण प्रदान करती है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ऋण की अवधि एक वर्ष है, और यह मासिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ऋण का समय पर या जल्दी चुकाने पर, विक्रेताओं को प्रति वर्ष 7% की ब्याज सब्सिडी मिलती है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • इस योजना का उद्देश्य न केवल ऋण प्रदान करके बल्कि कैशबैक ऑफ़र के माध्यम से डिजिटल लेनदेन को प्रोत्साहित करके भी पथ विक्रेताओं को सशक्त बनाना है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          సరైన సమాధానం 1 సంవత్సరం.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • PM-SVANidhi పథకాన్ని గృహనిర్మాణ, పట్టణ వ్యవహారాల మంత్రిత్వ శాఖ 2020 జూన్‌లో ప్రారంభించింది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ఈ పథకం పట్టణ వీధి వ్యాపారులకు ₹10,000 వరకు వర్కింగ్ క్యాపిటల్ రుణాలను అందిస్తుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • రుణ కాలపరిమితి ఒక సంవత్సరం, మరియు దీనిని నెలవారీ వాయిదాలలో తిరిగి చెల్లించాలి.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • రుణాన్ని సకాలంలో లేదా ముందుగా తిరిగి చెల్లించినట్లయితే, వ్యాపారులు సంవత్సరానికి 7% వడ్డీ సబ్సిడీకి అర్హులు.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ఈ పథకం రుణాలను అందించడమే కాకుండా క్యాష్‌బ్యాక్ ఆఫర్‌ల ద్వారా డిజిటల్ లావాదేవీలను ప్రోత్సహించడం ద్వారా వీధి వ్యాపారులకు సాధికారత కల్పించడం లక్ష్యంగా పెట్టుకుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • అర్హత:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • పట్టణ ప్రాంతాల్లోని వీధి వ్యాపారులు, చుట్టుపక్కల పాక్షిక-పట్టణ/గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాల్లో వ్యాపారం చేసే వారు కూడా.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 2020 మార్చి 24న లేదా అంతకు ముందు వ్యాపారంలో ఉన్న వ్యాపారులు.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • రుణ లక్షణాలు:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
