                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The given sentence is an example of a legal term usage where \"acquitted\" should be followed by \"of\" instead of \"to\".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The correct form is \"He was acquitted of a cyber crime.\"
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The preposition \"of\" is used to indicate the reason or cause of the acquittal.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Correct sentence: He was acquitted of a cyber crime on the basis of evidence given to the court.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Acquittal:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Definition: A legal judgment that officially and formally clears a defendant of criminal charges.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Example: The jury acquitted him of all charges.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \nThe correct answer is '4' i.e. Please suggest me some tips to get out nervousness .

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The given sentence contains an error in the use of the phrasal verb.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In the context of providing suggestions or advice, the correct phrasing is \"Please suggest some tips\" without the use of \"me.\"
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The phrase \"to get out nervousness\" is also incorrect. The correct phrase should be \"to overcome nervousness\" or \"to get rid of nervousness.\"
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Correct sentence: Please suggest some tips to overcome nervousness.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Common Phrasal Verbs:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Back up: To make a copy of data (e.g., Back up your essential files).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Came across: To find something by chance (e.g., Pushpa came across an old photo).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Turn up: To increase the volume or intensity (e.g., Please turn up the heater).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Correct Usage:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Suggest: Should be used without \"me\" when giving general advice (e.g., Please suggest some tips).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Overcome/Get rid of: Appropriate phrases to express dealing with nervousness (e.g., to overcome nervousness).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The passage talks about Leif Erikson, who is historically known as a Viking explorer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Vinland is associated with Norse exploration, so the term "archaeologists" is appropriate for those who found evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • "Settlement" is the most fitting term to describe the area where Erikson's group lived.

Vinland is now thought to be at the northern tip of Canada's Newfoundland island where archaeologists found evidence of Erikson's settlement in 1960s..

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • 2nd Conditional Sentence:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Structure: If + past simple, would + base verb.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Example: If I were an astronaut, I would look at the stars all the time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The word \"difficult\" means something that is not easily or readily done; requiring much effort or skill to accomplish or understand. (कठिन)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Example: The exam was so difficult that many students couldn't finish it on time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \"Easy\" refers to something that is not difficult; requiring little effort or skill. (आसान)\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Example: The task was so easy that I completed it in just a few minutes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'difficult' is 'easy'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3 (easy).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Subject-Verb Agreement:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Rule: A singular subject requires a singular verb, and a plural subject requires a plural verb.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The word "caprice" means a sudden and unaccountable change of mood or behavior. (अचानक और अनियंत्रित परिवर्तन)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: His decision to move to another country was driven by a caprice rather than logical reasoning.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Impulse" refers to a sudden strong and unreflective urge or desire to act. (प्रेरणा)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: She bought the dress on an impulse, without thinking about the cost.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: She felt deep sorrow after the loss of her pet.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The word "Restraint" means a measure or condition that keeps someone or something under control; the action of keeping someone or something under control.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: Building self-esteem is crucial for personal development.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Self-acceptance (आत्म-स्वीकृति): Acceptance of oneself, including one's own strengths and weaknesses.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Proposal (प्रस्ताव): A plan that is formally suggested.\n\n\t
